1.explanation: This single `.qmd` file uses the `scrreprt` class and places a Definition, an Example, and a Theorem with a Proof after ordinary paragraph text. When you render it (`quarto render minimal.qmd`), you can measure the gap before each theorem environment. The blank line before `\end{proof}` demonstrates how Quarto’s generated proof environment shifts the QED symbol downward. Removing that blank line in the proof block will restore the symbol to its expected vertical position.
1.bug_scenario: The generated PDF shows noticeably large gaps between the preceding text and each definition/example/theorem block, compared to a hand-written LaTeX version. In addition the QED symbol in the proof is pushed down when there is a blank line before the `\end{proof}`.
